blockingFindings.title: R6 lacks coverage for the subsequent test-review-gate evaluation
blockingFindings.rationale: R6 explicitly requires permission for one subsequent test-review-gate evaluation; the current executable test stops at `test-execute`, so this acceptance requirement has no corresponding spec-local coverage.
blockingFindings.issue: The R6 test verifies that bounded repair recovery invalidates stale evidence and that `GetNextActionCommand` returns `test-execute` after recovery, but it does not cover the required one subsequent `test-review-gate` evaluation after the recovered test-execute/test-result-review path is completed.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Extend the R6 spec-local test to advance through the recovered test-execute and test-result-review leaf steps and assert that exactly one subsequent test-review-gate evaluation is permitted.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R6 explicitly requires permission for one subsequent test-review-gate evaluation; the current executable test stops at `test-execute`, so this acceptance requirement has no corresponding spec-local coverage.
